name: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited
summary: Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited operates as power plant equipment manufacturer in India and internationally. The company operates in two segments, Power and Industry. It offers equipment supplies; spares and services; and undertakes engineering, procurement, and construction works for coal and lignite, gas, hydro and nuclear power plant, transportation, transmission, defence, aerospace, captive power plants, process, renewables, upstream and downstream oil and gas, e-mobility and energy storage, and other industries.
